# RevContent

> RevContent is a native advertising platform that takes publisher monetization beyond the web page, into email newsletters, mobile apps, and Apple News. It connects more than 1,500 performance advertisers with over 75 million people each month, across 4,000+ sites and 500+ newsletters from 1,000+ direct publishers. Founded in 2013, RevContent is headquartered in Sarasota, Florida.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.revcontent.com/): overview of RevContent for publishers and advertisers
- [About RevContent](https://www.revcontent.com/about): company overview, key facts, channels, and leadership
- [Publishers](https://www.revcontent.com/publishers): native ad monetization for websites, newsletters, apps, and Apple News; no minimum traffic requirement, real-time reporting
- [Advertisers](https://www.revcontent.com/advertisers): native campaigns reaching 75M+ people a month, CPC or vCPM buying, pixel and S2S tracking, real-time reporting
- [Email Monetization](https://www.revcontent.com/email-monetization): native ads inside email newsletters; 500+ newsletters, 24 supported email platforms
- [FAQ](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/faq): payments, requirements, targeting, tracking, ad review, invalid traffic, and real-time reporting

## Guides

- [What Is Native Advertising?](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/what-is-native-advertising): definition, types, FTC disclosure rules, and market size
- [What Is a Native Ad Network?](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/what-is-a-native-ad-network): how native ad networks work and how they compare with ad exchanges and DSPs
- [What Is Email Newsletter Monetization?](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/what-is-email-newsletter-monetization): the four newsletter revenue models and how ad networks work in email

## Company

- [Meet the Team](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/meet-the-team): leadership and team
- [Careers](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/careers): open roles
- [Contact](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/contact-us): contact RevContent
- [Contact Advertiser Sales](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/contact-us-advertisers): advertiser sales contact

## Getting started

- [Publisher Application](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/revcontent-publisher-application): apply to monetize a website or app
- [Email Publisher Application](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/email-publisher-application): apply to monetize a newsletter
- [Advertiser Registration](https://www.revcontent.com/registration): create an advertiser account
- [Advertiser Getting Started](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/advertisers-getting-started): launch a first campaign
- [Help Center](https://help.revcontent.com/knowledge): setup, payments, and policies

## Resources

- [Blog](https://www.revcontent.com/resources/blog): articles on native advertising and publisher monetization
